data.text: Erik's direction: a calm dashboard of all MY insurance (personal assistant, not B2B). Agents find better deals and negotiate in parallel by REAL phone calls (GPT-Live) and email (AgentMail). Tap into any live agent to see transcript + everything it knows. Demo: several team members get called at once by agents, we watch/listen live.
Each negotiation runs as its own Fly.io Machine (same image, worker entrypoint), state shared via Neon docs table; dashboard streams updates over SSE.
